Wait, Testimony 3 says Metis fell down near the round window on the workbench side of the room. But evidence 9 says the victim (Metis) was on the operating table, with the workbench on the other side. So if the workbench was on the other side of the room from the operating table, then the workbench side of the room would be where the workbench is. So if Metis fell near the round window on the workbench side, but in the photos, she was on the operating table, which is on the opposite side. So there's a contradiction here.
